description: List all listings owned or brokered by the authenticated user, under `listings`, each with its status, price, views over the last 30 days, public `url` (live listings only) and `editor_url`. Optionally filter by status. Requires authentication. Shows the user a panel where they can change a price, publish a draft or take a live listing off the market.

status.description: Filter by listing status. Omit to return all statuses.

name: list_my_listings
title: List my listings
